text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said Monday that it is restructuring its Pacific division, which oversees the operations of 16 hospitals, 15 surgery centers, 10 home-health agencies and a statewide PPO network in California.
Richard Bracken, who was the president of the Columbia Pacific Division recently accepted a position as president of a long-term-care company.
Columbia said it appointed Ronald Phelps president of the Southern California Division in San Diego, and Thomas May president of the Northern California Division in San Jose.
Phelps is currently the chief executive officer of Columbia Los Robles Medical Center, Thousand Oaks, Calif.
May is currently the president and chief executive officer of the Columbia Bay Area Healthcare Network in San Jose, Calif.
